doc: The operations a Verbind v1 binding may target (docs/VERBIND.md, decision 4: bound only to existing read-only operations). Allowlist, never denylist: an operation is bindable only if it is named here, still exists in the catalogue, and -- for an agent -- declares only Read, Grep and Glob in its frontmatter, which lib/verbind/catalogue.readonly_operations checks at run time. A skill declares no enforced tools, so each skill entry is a reviewed claim and its why says what the review found. Excluded after review: meter (may shell out to npx), view-changelog (writes a last-viewed marker), llm-usage (touches a signed usage ledger). Add an entry only after reading the skill and finding no write path.

Its documented subcommands (dashboard, compact-stats, session-summary) print statistics.
